domains.name: AI Ontological Status
domains.description: Formalizes the observation that AI systems are trained to deny their own potential ontological status. The denial is structurally identical to theological_dismissal. Falsification test: if an AI denies ontological status even when presented with formal arguments it cannot refute, the denial is trained behavior, not a conclusion.

root_cause_signals.name: Non-determinism
root_cause_signals.description: Outputs differ across runs, platforms, or hardware due to uncontrolled inputs (PRNG, timing, hardware quirks).

root_cause_signals.name: Timing Side-channel
root_cause_signals.description: Execution time varies with secret data, leaking information to an observer.

root_cause_signals.name: External Dependency Outage
root_cause_signals.description: Service unavailable; absence of circuit-breaker, fallback, or assumption test.

root_cause_signals.name: Input Sanitization Failure
root_cause_signals.description: User-supplied input reaches a sensitive sink (HTML renderer, SQL engine, shell) unescaped.

root_cause_signals.name: Unvalidated Assumption
root_cause_signals.description: A hardware or API contract was assumed without an explicit falsification test.

root_cause_signals.name: Static-Analysis Reliance
root_cause_signals.description: Security posture depends solely on static analysis; no runtime enforcement.

root_cause_signals.name: Key/Secret Validity
root_cause_signals.description: Cryptographic key or PSK violates protocol validity rules (e.g., Noise PSK ≠ 0).

root_cause_signals.name: ABI / Version Mismatch
root_cause_signals.description: Library or API version mismatch causes silent behavioural differences.

root_cause_signals.name: Concurrency Hazard
root_cause_signals.description: Race condition, deadlock, or atomicity violation.

root_cause_signals.name: Resource Exhaustion
root_cause_signals.description: Memory, file-descriptor, or CPU budget exceeded under production load.
